_about: The issues drawn on the demo, from review.py check on review/probe-before.json (measured) or by looking (seen). capture.py turns each selector into a box with __od.marks(). short is the one line the animation shows as it finds the issue; token is what the fix applies.

before.title: Three filled buttons compete, and white on green reads at 3.3:1
before.short: 3 filled buttons, and white on green at 3.3:1
before.gives: the next step obvious: one filled button, New invoice, and every label readable

before.title: Gray text is hard to read
before.short: Gray text at 2.54:1, where it needs 4.5:1
before.gives: dates, emails and column titles readable for everyone

before.title: Amounts don't line up
before.short: Amounts left-aligned, in digits of uneven width
before.gives: amounts quick to compare, right-aligned with digits of equal width

before.title: Status is shown by color alone
before.gives: status clear to everyone, including people who can't tell red from green: each one says Paid, Due or Overdue
before.token: status: a label and an icon
before.stat: a dot → a label and an icon

before.title: Row buttons are small, with vague names
before.gives: row actions easy to hit, and each button names its invoice for screen readers

before.title: Corners, text sizes and colors are off the system
before.short: Corners, sizes and colors from no system
before.gives: the page look like one product: every corner, size and color comes from Merriweft's tokens
before.before: 3 corner radii, 5 text sizes and 12 colors off Merriweft's tokens
before.finding: measured against the tokens (MS-09, MS-02, MS-08)

before.title: The chart repeats a number and shows no values
before.short: The chart repeats Paid in October, and shows no values
before.gives: one place for each number, and a chart you can read: each week's total against September's average
before.before: $112.5k shown twice; 4 bars, no values, 8 px labels at 1.47:1
before.after: shown once; a value on every bar; 12 px labels at 7.23:1
before.finding: seen on the page, and measured label colors

after.title: One figure, a chart with numbers
